title: georender.json
description: Render bundle for a geocontext repository: declares a default ruleset, asset collections, render extent, and canvas defaults. The renderer (https://github.com/openfantasymap/georender) reads this file from `cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/<owner>/<repo>@<ref>/georender.json` when invoked in `--mode geocontext`. The runtime parser tolerates // and /* */ comments and trailing commas, so this schema does not constrain whitespace or comments — only the resulting structure.

ruleset.description: Either a path (relative to the repo root) to a ruleset JSON file, or an inline ruleset object. Path strings are fetched via jsDelivr; inline objects are registered directly with the runtime RulesetStore.

oneOf.description: Path inside the geocontext repo, e.g. `"ruleset.json"` or `"styles/sketchy.json"`.

assets.description: Asset collections registered with the renderer for this bundle. Each collection name maps to a dict of asset definitions whose `file` paths may be bare-relative (auto-rewritten to `github://<owner>/<repo>@<ref>/...`), `github://` URIs, or absolute `http(s)://` URLs.

base.description: Default render center + zoom (used as a fallback extent when neither `bbox` nor `--bbox` is supplied).

bbox.description: Default render extent as [west, south, east, north] in EPSG:4326 decimal degrees. Takes precedence over `base` when both are present.

render.description: Default canvas dimensions. CLI flags (--width / --height / --padding) override individual fields when present.

geocontext.description: Overrides for the data side of the geocontext source. All fields are optional; the renderer defaults pick the right values when omitted.

manifest.description: Manifest filename inside the repo. Defaults to `geocontext.json` then `gcx.json`.

layers.description: Layer name whitelist — only features belonging to data-driven layers in this list are returned. Omit to include every data-driven layer.

assetFileRef.description: A path or URI to an asset file. Forms: a bare-relative path (`backgrounds/x.jpg`, auto-anchored to the geocontext repo), `github://<owner>/<repo>[@<ref>]/<path>`, or an absolute `http(s)://` URL.

randomization.description: Per-stamp deterministic randomization applied during asset materialization. Seed is derived from rule + feature index + position, so adjacent renders stay visually stable.

oneOf.description: Pick uniformly from the listed degrees.

assetEntry.description: A single asset definition. Either a plain file (`{file: ..., kind?: ...}`) or a `variant_set` with weighted variants.

kind.description: Free-form tag describing the asset's intended use. The renderer doesn't gate on this; tooling can.

bounds.description: For raster overlays: [W,S,E,N] in EPSG:4326 (metadata only — not consumed by the symbolizer yet).

inlineRuleset.description: Full inline ruleset object. The renderer's validation runs at load time — see https://github.com/openfantasymap/georender/blob/main/README.md#rulesets for the rule schema. Only the high-level shape is constrained here.
